description: Canonical required facts consumed by TaskKernel for both attempt publication and accepted-result reads.

semantics.baseline_commit: Git baseline commit verified in the producer repository
semantics.decision_ref: Optional task-relative canonical decision receipt; requires decision_hash
semantics.decision_hash: SHA-256 of the exact decision receipt bytes

semantics.revision: Positive plan/tasks pair revision authenticated by immutable component receipts
semantics.pair_id: Shared identity binding the plan and tasks receipts for this revision
semantics.research: Passing official workflowhub-build-plan-fact.v1 research receipt reference and hash
semantics.analysis: Passing official workflowhub-build-plan-fact.v1 cross-artifact analysis receipt reference and hash
semantics.simplicity: Passing official workflowhub-build-plan-fact.v1 simplicity receipt reference and hash
semantics.review: Passing formal attempt-scoped wh-review result reference, hash, verdict, and snapshot tree

semantics.changed: List of changed artifacts from this stage
semantics.review: Task-relative wh-review result_ref plus its snapshot_tree. Consumers must open the formal result and must not trust a copied verdict.
semantics.phase_completion: Phase completion facts copied from accepted PHASE_RESULT records, or provenance-bound legacy commit migration records that visibly mark missing canonical phase reports

semantics.tests: Fresh verification command and physical result facts
semantics.quality_note: Optional human-facing quality summary; not an automatic gate
